title: More room for your work
items: Work in a workspace with Main, named channels, and workers grouped in the dock.
Follow worker progress and failures, and answer decisions that stay in Needs you.
Keep your plan in the blackboard, with milestones, linked cards, and changes Main asks you to approve.
Read charts and diagrams in your workspace, including board release progress charts.
Save named layouts in this browser and restore your tabs, splits, and panel sizes.
Print viewer content and download messages as Markdown.
Get back to work faster with quicker startup connections and smoother workspace switching.
Open live ticket details beside the board, with a full-content view on phones.
